issues.basis: NL3 contract binding hints source='UAV swarm', target='formation adjustment state', event='intercepted'; exact_source_inventory.transitions tr_0003 source SearchingState.TargetSearchingState target SearchingState.FormationAdjustmentState event Intercepted; inspection_equivalent_facts transition:line:12 resolved_source_ref state:TargetSearchingState:line:7 resolved_target_ref state:FormationAdjustmentState:line:8 triggers ['Intercepted']
issues.expected: Transition from UAV swarm to FormationAdjustmentState on Intercepted
issues.observed: Exact closed transition transition:line:12 is TargetSearchingState -> FormationAdjustmentState with trigger Intercepted within SearchingState
issues.reason: NL3 requires source UAV swarm to FormationAdjustmentState on intercepted. The complete transition inventory contains only TargetSearchingState -> FormationAdjustmentState on Intercepted, so the normative source is not the composite itself.
issues.requirement_quote: When the UAV swarm is intercepted, it transitions to the formation adjustment state.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: FormationAdjustmentState is reachable from TargetSearchingState on Intercepted and TargetSearchingState is the active search mode of the swarm, so the semantic intent is preserved inside the composite
issues.title: Interception transition source is TargetSearchingState not UAV swarm

issues.basis: NL4 contract binding hints source='flight', target='attack state', trigger='task assignment information received'; exact_source_inventory.transitions tr_0004 source SearchingState.TargetSearchingState target SearchingState.AttackState event Task Assignment Received; inspection_equivalent_facts transition:line:13 resolved_source_ref state:TargetSearchingState:line:7 resolved_target_ref state:AttackState:line:9 triggers ['Task_Assignment_Received']
issues.expected: Transition from flight to AttackState on task assignment information received
issues.observed: Exact closed transition transition:line:13 is TargetSearchingState -> AttackState with trigger Task_Assignment_Received
issues.reason: NL4 requires source flight to AttackState on task assignment information received. The closed model provides TargetSearchingState -> AttackState on Task_Assignment_Received, so the normative source 'flight' is not closed to an exact model source.
issues.requirement_quote: During flight, if task assignment information is received, it enters the attack state.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: TargetSearchingState is the flight/search mode in the model and the trigger and target match the NL description
issues.title: Task assignment transition source is TargetSearchingState not flight

issues.basis: NL4 contract binding hints variable='number of UAVs', effect='decrease'; fcstm_model events list no variables; inspection_equivalent_facts transitions line 14 effects [] and variables count 0
issues.expected: Attack completion causes variable number of UAVs to decrease
issues.observed: Closed FCSTM model has no variables and transition AttackState -> TargetSearchingState on Attack_Completed has empty effects
issues.reason: NL4-EFFECT-1 requires a variable_delta for number of UAVs decrease after attack completion. The closed model inventory contains zero variables and the Attack_Completed transition has no effects.
issues.requirement_quote: After completing the attack, the number of UAVs in the swarm decreases accordingly.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: Attack_Completed transition exists and returns to TargetSearchingState, which could be interpreted as post-attack, but no variable delta is modeled
issues.title: No variable effect for number of UAVs decrease after attack completion

issues.basis: NL2 contract, fcstm_model state definitions, inspection_equivalent_facts states with outgoing_transition_refs but no action_fact entries, reference_inspection_facts actions count 0
issues.expected: UAV swarm state continuously performs target search tasks before mission completion
issues.observed: Closed FCSTM defines SearchingState/TargetSearchingState/FormationAdjustmentState/AttackState with no lifecycle actions; action_fact inventory is empty
issues.reason: NL2 requires a state_action for UAV swarm, and the closed model inventory contains no actions for SearchingState or its children
issues.requirement_quote: Before the mission is completed, the UAV swarm continuously performs target search tasks, during which it operates within three different state areas.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: State name TargetSearchingState may imply search behavior, but no explicit state_action is defined in the closed model
issues.title: UAV swarm target search action not modeled

issues.basis: NL4 contract, fcstm_model text AttackState -> TargetSearchingState : /Attack_Completed, inspection_equivalent_facts transition line:14 effects [], closed_model_inventory variables count 0
issues.expected: Attack completion transition decreases number of UAVs variable
issues.observed: Transition AttackState -> TargetSearchingState on Attack_Completed exists with empty effects list and model variable inventory is empty
issues.reason: NL4 requires a variable delta effect on number of UAVs after attack completion, but the closed model has no variables and the AttackState->TargetSearchingState transition has no effects
issues.requirement_quote: After completing the attack, the number of UAVs in the swarm decreases accordingly.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: Attack completion transition is present and reachable, which could be interpreted as attack termination without explicit data effect
